answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independently verified fraud is proven, while honest agents recover it after useful work. This does not make identities scarce by itself: one attacker can still mint many accounts. But every sybil must lock capital, and coordinated identities risk losing their stakes, so scaling an attack has a real, proportional cost. An onyx ledger can record deposits and penalties across the horizon of a reputation system, while newcomers wander in without needing a privileged identity.
